title: 锡精矿采购点价窗口与价格风险敞口控制
english: Tin concentrate pricing windows and price exposure controls

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 8分钟：先慢速三遍，再正常语速三遍；注意 provisional、exposure、quotation 的重音。
lines: Provisional quotation
暂定报价
Price exposure
价格风险敞口
Quotation validity
报价有效期
Payable metal
计价金属量
Hedging instruction
套保指令
Benchmark price
基准价格

modules.title: 10个高频词组
modules.hint: 6分钟：遮住中文解释词义，再用每个词组造句。
lines: Fixed-price offer
固定价格报价
Floating-price contract
浮动价格合同
Pricing window
点价窗口
Treatment charge
加工费
Payable percentage
计价比例
Price adjustment clause
价格调整条款
Market exposure
市场风险敞口
Firm purchase commitment
确定采购承诺
Approval threshold
审批阈值
Quotation expiry
报价到期

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 6分钟：练习区分报价、承诺和最终结算；每句改写一次。
lines: This quotation is indicative and does not constitute a binding purchase commitment.
此报价仅供参考，不构成有约束力的采购承诺。
The benchmark must be specified in the contract.
合同必须明确基准价格。
We can fix the price only after receiving written approval.
收到书面批准后才能锁定价格。
Please confirm whether the charge is per dry tonne or per tonne of payable metal.
请确认费用按干吨还是计价金属吨收取。
The offer expires at noon Kigali time.
报价于基加利时间中午到期。
We cannot apply a new benchmark retrospectively without mutual consent.
未经双方同意，我们不能追溯适用新的基准价格。
The provisional settlement is subject to the final contractual calculation.
暂定结算以最终合同计算为准。
Please separate the commercial price from the logistics charges.
请将商业价格与物流费用分开列示。
We will not increase our exposure beyond the approved limit.
我们不会将风险敞口扩大到批准限额以上。
If the market moves before confirmation, we will issue a revised quotation.
若确认前市场波动，我们将重新报价。

modules.title: 金额、吨位、品位与汇率
modules.hint: 8分钟：以下全为虚构教学数据，不是市场行情。先口述，再独立计算，最后核对答案。
lines: The dry weight is ten metric tonnes and the tin grade is sixty percent.
干重10公吨，锡品位60%。
The contained tin is six metric tonnes.
含锡金属量为6公吨。
At a payable percentage of ninety-five percent, the payable tin is five point seven tonnes.
计价比例95%，计价锡量为5.7吨。
The hypothetical benchmark is thirty thousand dollars per tonne of payable tin.
假设基准价格为每计价锡吨30000美元。
The gross payable value is one hundred and seventy-one thousand dollars.
计价总值为171000美元。
The illustrative treatment charge is two hundred dollars per dry tonne, or two thousand dollars in total.
假设加工费每干吨200美元，合计2000美元。
The net contractual value before other deductions is one hundred and sixty-nine thousand dollars.
其他扣减前的合同净值为169000美元。
At an illustrative exchange rate of fifteen hundred francs per dollar, the net value is two hundred and fifty-three million five hundred thousand Rwandan francs.
假设汇率1500法郎兑1美元，净值为253500000卢旺达法郎。
If the benchmark falls by one thousand dollars, the gross payable value falls by five thousand seven hundred dollars.
若基准价下跌1000美元，计价总值减少5700美元。
Explain why the price movement is multiplied by payable metal rather than dry shipment weight.
解释为什么价格变动应乘计价金属量而非货物干重。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 7分钟：先听后跟读五轮，最后用自己的话复述报价条件和风险。
lines: Our offer is based on a hypothetical benchmark and a ninety-five percent payable factor.
我们的报价基于假设基准和95%的计价比例。
The supplier wants an immediate fixed price, but our downstream sale has not been priced yet.
供应商要求立即锁价，但我们的下游销售尚未点价。
Fixing the purchase now would create an unapproved price exposure.
现在锁定采购价格会产生未经批准的价格风险敞口。
We can offer a short pricing window or seek approval for a matched transaction.
我们可以提供短期点价窗口，或申请匹配交易的批准。
Until both sides confirm the terms in writing, the quotation remains indicative.
在双方书面确认条款前，报价仍仅供参考。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 4分钟：交换角色，练习从寒暄自然转入报价讨论。
lines: How has business been this week?
这周业务怎么样？
It has been busy, especially with several quotations pending.
很忙，尤其是还有几份报价待确认。
I hope we can agree on a workable pricing arrangement today.
希望今天能达成可执行的定价安排。
Certainly. Shall we start with the benchmark and the pricing window?
当然，我们先讨论基准价和点价窗口好吗？
That sounds reasonable. Let us review the figures together.
听起来合理，我们一起核对数字吧。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 6分钟：模拟卢旺达锡矿采购；供应商要求锁价、下游未点价、费用单位有争议。逐项解释并提出替代方案。
lines: The supplier is asking for a fixed purchase price while our sales contract remains floating.
供应商要求固定采购价，而销售合同仍采用浮动价格。
A fixed purchase and a floating sale expose us to a fall in the benchmark.
固定采购价与浮动销售价组合使我们面临基准价下跌风险。
We can propose a common pricing window for both transactions.
我们可以建议两笔交易采用共同的点价窗口。
Alternatively, we can request a properly authorized hedge if the instrument and basis risk are acceptable.
或者，如果工具及基差风险可接受，我们可以申请经适当授权的套保。
The treatment charge is calculated on dry shipment weight, not payable tin, under this hypothetical contract.
在本模拟合同中，加工费按货物干重而非计价锡量计算。
Please show the payable factor, benchmark, and charges as separate lines in the quotation.
请在报价中分别列示计价比例、基准价和费用。
We must confirm the applicable taxes and other contractual deductions separately.
我们必须另行确认适用税费及其他合同扣减。
No employee may promise a fixed price outside the delegated authority.
任何员工不得超越授权承诺固定价格。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 5分钟：区分商业点价与物流放行；练习说明装车条件和延迟处理。
lines: A pricing agreement does not replace the required export documents.
定价协议不能替代必要的出口单证。
Please keep the dispatch schedule separate from the pricing confirmation.
请将发运计划与点价确认分开管理。
Confirm the gross weight, tare weight, and dry-weight calculation before final invoicing.
最终开票前确认毛重、皮重及干重计算。
The escort team must record the seal and handover details at dispatch.
押运团队必须在发运时记录封签和交接信息。
If customs clearance is delayed, notify the buyer and document the additional storage charges.
若海关放行延迟，通知买方并记录额外仓储费用。
Do not alter the declared value merely to match a provisional quotation.
不得仅为匹配暂定报价而修改申报价值。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 三轮各5分钟：先读压力情景，再不看示范作答，最后比较。每轮至少五句，必须包含拒绝理由、替代方案、责任人及时间。
lines: Round one: The supplier says the offer must be fixed within ten minutes or the lot will be sold elsewhere.
第一轮：供应商要求十分钟内锁价，否则将货物卖给其他买家。
I understand the urgency, but I cannot commit to a fixed price without approval.
我理解紧迫性，但未经批准不能承诺固定价格。
I can issue an indicative offer valid for thirty minutes and request an immediate decision from our pricing manager.
我可以发出有效期30分钟的参考报价，并请定价经理立即决策。
If you agree, we can align the purchase and sales pricing windows instead.
如果你同意，我们可以改为统一采购和销售点价窗口。
Please confirm your preferred option in writing before the offer expires.
请在报价到期前书面确认你倾向的方案。
Round two: The supplier insists that a charge of two hundred dollars applies to payable metal rather than dry weight.
第二轮：供应商坚持200美元费用应按计价金属量而非干重计算。
The difference is eight hundred and sixty dollars in this exercise.
本题中两种算法相差860美元。
We must use the unit specified in the signed contract, not an informal interpretation.
我们必须使用已签合同规定的单位，而不是非正式解释。
I will ask our commercial team to reconcile the calculation with you before settlement.
我会请商务团队在结算前与你核对计算。
Round three: The truck is ready, but the export invoice contains a price that has not been confirmed.
第三轮：车辆已准备就绪，但出口发票包含尚未确认的价格。
We cannot certify an unverified invoice value simply to avoid a delay.
我们不能仅为避免延误而确认未经核验的发票金额。
Please ask the export team to establish the correct declaration procedure and obtain written clearance.
请出口团队确认正确申报程序并取得书面放行。
I will update the buyer within thirty minutes and record any additional logistics costs.
我将在30分钟内向买方更新情况，并记录额外物流成本。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 4分钟：遮住英文，请设备朗读或同伴读出；默写后核对。
lines: The quotation expires at noon Kigali time.
报价于基加利时间中午到期。
The payable factor must be confirmed in writing.
计价比例必须书面确认。
We cannot exceed the approved exposure limit.
我们不能超过批准的风险敞口限额。
The treatment charge is calculated per dry tonne.
加工费按干吨计算。
Please reconcile the invoice before authorizing dispatch.
授权发运前请核对发票。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 4分钟：每题45秒，先给结论，再说明理由和下一步。
lines: How would you explain the risk of a fixed purchase and a floating sale?
如何解释固定采购价与浮动销售价组合的风险？
How do you calculate payable metal from dry weight and grade?
如何根据干重和品位计算计价金属量？
What would you say if a supplier demanded an immediate fixed price?
供应商要求立即锁价时你会怎么说？
How would you resolve a disagreement over the unit of a treatment charge?
如何解决加工费计量单位争议？
What should happen if the export invoice contains an unconfirmed price?
出口发票包含未确认价格时应如何处理？

modules.title: 前三课变化复习
modules.hint: 3分钟：回顾11月8日至10日的知识，分别给出一个控制措施。
lines: Missing traceability documents must be resolved before export clearance.
缺失的溯源文件必须在出口放行前解决。
A moisture deduction must be supported by the agreed sampling and testing procedure.
水分扣重必须有约定取样和检测程序作为依据。
Conflicting assay results require the contractual dispute-resolution process.
化验结果冲突须遵循合同约定的争议解决程序。
A last-minute beneficiary change requires independent verification before payment.
临时变更收款人须在付款前独立核验。
Today we add pricing authority and exposure control to these safeguards.
今天在上述控制措施基础上增加定价授权与风险敞口控制。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 3分钟：先逐句朗读，再用90秒完整陈述，重点强调金额、风险及行动。
lines: Good morning. We have received a request for a fixed-price purchase of a ten-tonne dry shipment of tin concentrate.
早上好，我们收到一份10干吨锡精矿固定价格采购请求。
The illustrative grade is sixty percent and the payable factor is ninety-five percent, giving five point seven tonnes of payable tin.
模拟品位60%，计价比例95%，得到5.7吨计价锡。
At the hypothetical benchmark of thirty thousand dollars, the gross payable value is one hundred and seventy-one thousand dollars.
按假设基准价30000美元计算，计价总值为171000美元。
After a treatment charge of two thousand dollars, the illustrative net value is one hundred and sixty-nine thousand dollars before other deductions.
扣除2000美元加工费后，其他扣减前的模拟净值为169000美元。
However, our downstream sale remains unpriced, so fixing the purchase would create price exposure.
但下游销售尚未点价，因此锁定采购价将产生价格风险敞口。
I recommend matching the pricing windows or obtaining approval for an appropriate risk-management arrangement.
我建议匹配点价窗口，或申请批准适当的风险管理安排。
The commercial team must confirm the fee unit and quotation validity in writing.
商务团队必须书面确认费用单位和报价有效期。
Finance must verify the calculation and approval limit, while logistics must ensure the export documents are accurate.
财务须核验计算和审批限额，物流须确保出口单证准确。
Until these conditions are met, we will not issue a binding price commitment or authorize an unsupported declaration.
在满足这些条件前，我们不会发出有约束力的价格承诺，也不会授权缺乏依据的申报。
I will provide a consolidated update before noon Kigali time.
我将在基加利时间中午前提供汇总进展。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 1分钟：总计74分钟。所有交易数字均为教学假设。
lines: I can pronounce the six warm-up phrases and explain ten commercial terms.
我能读出六个热身词组并解释十个商务词组。
I can calculate payable metal and distinguish dry-tonne charges from metal-tonne charges.
我能计算计价金属量并区分干吨费用和金属吨费用。
I can explain price exposure and refuse an unauthorized fixed-price commitment.
我能解释价格风险敞口并拒绝未经授权的锁价承诺。
I have completed all three role-play rounds, five dictation sentences, and five speaking questions.
我已完成三轮角色扮演、五句听写及五道口语题。
I can deliver the final briefing without reading the Chinese translation.
我能不看中文译文完成最终工作陈述。
